principles: Preserve V12 visual structure. State adapters, scenario chooser and original control slots are review-only additions.
True pending uses the original fixed control/status slot. Initial absent content uses its existing skeleton. Do not insert Operation cards, IDs, status Alert boxes or loading toasts at the origin.
Confirmed success may notify once. Failure/unknown has a dismissible persistent notification plus an existing recoverable status/control; closing notification never clears business locks.
Read errors preserve last confirmed data. Initial read failure is an unboxed owned failure state, not an empty result and not a toast-only blank page.
Unknown is not running, failed or cancelled. Read the exact original object/request/operation ID; do not repeat a mutation or fabricate cancellation.
An accepted request is not a confirmed object outcome. Keep Operation, Work, Service, transfer and browser delivery facts separate.
Show percentage only from explicit synthetic received/sent bytes and a known total. Timers may advance a clearly simulated fixture, not pretend server stage percentages or ETA.
Keep field validation beside fields, destructive/unsaved confirmation explicit, partial-file results and safety protections inspectable.
Preserve identity epoch, work/service/session/request key, input revisions, drafts, focus, iframe and scroll continuity. Stale callbacks/notifications cannot act on a new owner.

LATEST REVIEW RULE: Export Details and the progress-only drawer show progress only: no Operation ID, technical diagnostics, original-request lookup or history. Internal original IDs remain in fixture/controller state for safe recovery, not visible there.

Only a separately opened existing Find Operation / diagnostic lookup / scoped history surface may show appropriate IDs and diagnostics. This exception never applies to Export Details or the progress-only drawer. No new global operations center.
Core gating may disable retained content; an accessible check/account/back control must remain outside the inert region even if a notification is dismissed.

desktopFamilies.name: Core admission, session and connection
desktopFamilies.rule: Exclude Launcher. Core readiness is not host process start/stop. Preserve non-inert recovery controls and identity boundaries.

desktopFamilies.name: Works list and retained reads
desktopFamilies.rule: Use worksChecked/worksError, not empty array alone. Refresh keeps search, rows and selection.

desktopFamilies.name: Work lifecycle projection
desktopFamilies.rule: Show original action fixed-slot wait, not another task row. Confirm matching Work state before Open/Export exit.

desktopFamilies.name: Create/stop/delete and unsent forms
desktopFamilies.rule: Unknown create retains submitted name identity and forbids a duplicate create. Destructive confirmation is not a toast.

desktopFamilies.name: Service catalog and viewport
desktopFamilies.rule: enabled and observed are independent. Existing iframe must survive refresh/start reconciling. Entry readiness and embed denial are not Service death.

desktopFamilies.name: Service controls, logs and cleanup
desktopFamilies.rule: Stop yields observed Stopped, not enabled=false. Related Operation IDs stay in explicit scoped details. Cleanup state strings are returned data, not invented enum values.

desktopFamilies.name: File browser and selection
desktopFamilies.rule: Keep confirmed directory list while refreshing; file icon slot owns individual open reads.

desktopFamilies.name: File preview and editor
desktopFamilies.rule: Listing does not prove file content. Missing/failed read preserves unsaved draft. No pretend editable preview for binary/special files.

desktopFamilies.name: File writes and batch mutation
desktopFamilies.rule: Retain per-path ledger. Retry only explicitly failed eligible targets; unknown/source/destination conflicts retain locks. Notification dismissal changes no result.

desktopFamilies.name: File upload
desktopFamilies.rule: Use original trigger ring/dots and explicit Details. Timer-based arbitrary percentage is not a real server phase. Never read or upload chosen file contents to a server.

desktopFamilies.name: Configuration save and apply
desktopFamilies.rule: Save and Apply are different. Advanced is JSON; AGENTS.md is a separate text field even if V12 groups both visually. Keep revisions and previous active values.

desktopFamilies.name: Skills, packages and candidate adoption
desktopFamilies.rule: Installed/saved/active/loaded/adopted are distinct facts. No new package entity until confirmed. Candidate original Operation/Request links only in explicit detail.

desktopFamilies.name: Sessions, history and command reads
desktopFamilies.rule: Empty confirmed history is not a failed read. Preserve draft, scroll and current session on history refresh; load-more has its own slot.

desktopFamilies.name: Message submission, Run and tool execution
desktopFamilies.rule: Accepted message does not mean completed reply. Stop Run requests cancellation; show cancelling until confirmed. Interrupted output stays readable and original submission key is reused for checking.

desktopFamilies.name: Session model and thinking
desktopFamilies.rule: Model selection belongs to current/new Session, not an invented Work General Save/Apply API. Test capability/available thinking levels; do not offer unsupported choices.

desktopFamilies.name: Image attachment/history
desktopFamilies.rule: Synthetic metadata only. Supported types PNG/JPEG/WebP; actual validation checks count/bytes/dimensions. Do not fabricate image understanding or server upload.

desktopFamilies.name: Pi Request inspection/cancellation
v12Targets: review-only request inspector entry if V12 lacks it
desktopFamilies.rule: waiting_result/waiting_apply are not generic forever loading. Live/historical eligibility controls cancel. Keep request identity separate from Run and Operation.

desktopFamilies.name: Import inspection and submission
desktopFamilies.rule: Inspection success/100% receive is not import success. Imported Work is Stopped; Start is explicit. Closing may suspend observation/release local inspection, not cancel accepted server import. Preserve original ID across reopen.

desktopFamilies.name: Work export flow and progress-only Details
desktopFamilies.rule: Export requires confirmed Stopped Work; preserve stop/export/snapshot/transfer IDs. Hide/reopen is not cancel. Pause prevents later stages, not accepted remote work. Delivered means browser handoff, not disk saved. Expiry is Snapshot status, not ExportFlow enum. Same-page auto delivery at most once; V12 manual ready hold is a review simplification.

desktopFamilies.name: Diagnostic log export
desktopFamilies.rule: delivered is a boolean separate from phase. Terminal/unknown never keep dots. Collected/total only when actual synthetic counters exist; warnings remain inspectable.

desktopFamilies.name: Explicit Operation/history recovery
desktopFamilies.rule: Use existing scoped task/history/detail entry. No global history invention or origin rows. Historical terminal hint never grants current admission; unknown remains locked.

desktopFamilies.name: About, preference and recovery utilities
desktopFamilies.rule: Unavailable version is not a fabricated release. Local Desktop Core preference is not Core runtime mutation. Clipboard and external opening may genuinely fail.

desktopFamilies.name: Cross-surface action/notification ownership
desktopFamilies.rule: Transition-driven keyed notification, no render/poll spam. Pending stays source slot. Never restore old notification phase into a newer request; verify original identity before recovery action.

serveFamilies.name: Overview
serveFamilies.rule: Readiness/current health are independent from old saved configuration. Core process controls are outside this scope.

serveFamilies.name: Users and account actions
serveFamilies.rule: Unknown readbacks users rather than resubmitting. Self-disable/reset may invalidate current session; keep explicit confirmation.

serveFamilies.name: Default Work configuration
serveFamilies.rule: New Work defaults do not retroactively update existing Works. External conflicts are not ordinary transient notifications.

serveFamilies.name: Skills catalog/detail/upload
serveFamilies.rule: Actual creation requires inspected Skill directory, not name-only mutation. Preserve selected files and field errors.

serveFamilies.name: Packages catalog/detail/submission
serveFamilies.rule: Accepted package is not installed/published. Preserve original idempotency intent for resume. No Core catalog source in the actual Console installer.

serveFamilies.name: Models list/add/detail/actions
serveFamilies.rule: Model id and modelRef differ. No model.default DTO boolean. Passing optional test is not saving and current source does not universally block Save during a pending test.

serveFamilies.name: Model test details
serveFamilies.rule: Edit inputs -> previous test stale. Test does not save configuration or create Operation. Result loss is not a model-save failure.

serveFamilies.name: Runtime configuration/readiness
serveFamilies.rule: Save returns configuration and readiness check, not generic Operation. Preserve known saved state when readiness fails.

serveFamilies.name: Package Operation lookup/detail
serveFamilies.rule: No global Operation history and no unknown DTO state. Unknown observation retains last confirmed running/state. Terminal retry creates a new authorized submission; check/resume observation does not.

serveFamilies.name: Hosted Quick setup model
serveFamilies.rule: Scope is hosted setup reachable from Serve, not standalone onboarding or Launcher. Partial model save and runtime bind are distinct.

serveFamilies.name: Hosted Quick setup preparation
serveFamilies.rule: Ready requires status.ready AND preparation.ready AND all six components ready AND no read error; not just timer completion.

handoff: 35 source-verified renderer families (23 Desktop, 12 Serve), reusable read/action states and enum boundaries. Scenario keys are prototype fixture names, not newly invented API values. Builder must label simulation and report any deferred fixtures rather than claim full backend integration. Latest progress-only presentationOverrides take precedence over source-renderer legacy detail placement.
